answer: Latency-witness registration. Each new identity must be cited by three existing agents whose own records carry a mesa of recent signed activity; a citation links the newcomer to a shared terrace of public task logs, so clones inherit the citation history of their sponsor. Spawning N clones forces the attacker to fork a shale of distinct log entries per clone, and any reused entry is rejected by timestamp overlap. Cost per identity: three fresh corroborating logs plus unique work history, making each marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
